title: The same size of news
hook: Two stated cases: explore different weights on equally sized news.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How different weights on equally sized news affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Posterior, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare different weights on equally sized news in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Different update weights can create asymmetric learning from equally informative news. The toy rule is an assumption, not a psychological measurement. This comparison isolates different weights on equally sized news.
